tools.name: get_my_courses
tools.description: List the student's active Google Classroom classes with their IDs. Use this when the user asks 'What classes am I in?' or needs a course ID to pass to another tool.

tools.name: get_todo
tools.description: Everything assigned that the student has not turned in yet, each with a link to open it in Classroom. Pass course_ids to limit it, or leave empty for all active classes. Use this when the user asks 'What do I still have to do?' or 'What's left to turn in across all my classes?'

tools.name: export_due_dates_calendar
tools.description: Build an ICS calendar file of upcoming due dates so they can be imported into a calendar app. Pass course_ids to limit it, or leave empty for all active classes. Use this when the user asks 'Can you give me my due dates as a calendar file?'

tools.name: get_upcoming_due_dates
tools.description: Work that is due soon and not turned in, soonest first. Pass course_ids or days_ahead to narrow it, or leave both empty. Use this when the user asks 'What's due this week across all my classes?' or 'What's coming up?'

tools.name: get_missing_assignments
tools.description: Past due work that has not been turned in. Pass course_ids to limit it, or leave empty for all active classes. Use this when the user asks 'What's overdue?' or 'What am I behind on?'

tools.name: get_assignments
tools.description: Assignments for one class with due dates and status, each with a link to open it in Classroom. Use this when the user asks 'What's due in this class?' or wants every assignment and its points for a single class.

tools.name: get_my_grades
tools.description: Grades on returned work for each class, with the comment the teacher left on the work. Google Classroom has no overall grade, so this adds up graded work only, and adds a weighted percent when the class uses grading categories with weights. Pass course_ids to limit it, or leave empty for all active classes. Use this when the user asks 'How am I doing in my classes?' or 'What grades have I gotten back?'

tools.name: get_target_grade
tools.description: Points needed on the work that is left to reach a target percent in each class. Adds up the points earned on graded work and the points the work left is worth, then says how many of those points you still need. target_percent is the percent you want, from 0 to 100. Pass course_ids to limit it, or leave empty for all active classes. Use this when the user asks 'What do I need to score to get a 90?' or 'Can I still get an A in this class?'

tools.name: get_announcements
tools.description: Recent announcements, each with a link to open it in Classroom. Pass course_ids or since_days to limit how far back they go, or leave empty for all active classes. Use this when the user asks 'Did my teacher post anything new?' or 'What did my teacher announce?'

tools.name: get_course_materials
tools.description: Posted materials for one class, each with a link to open it in Classroom and the Drive link of every attached file. Use this when the user asks 'What materials did my teacher post?' or wants the readings, slides and handouts for one class.

tools.name: get_whats_new
tools.description: One catch up digest for every class: new announcements, newly graded work with the comment the teacher left, overdue work and what is due next. Pass course_ids to limit it, since_days for how far back to look and days_ahead for how far ahead to look. Use this when the user asks 'What's new since yesterday?' or 'What changed in my classes?'
